name: Alpha-Neoendorphin
summary: α-Neoendorphin is an endogenous opioid peptide with a decapeptide structure and the amino acid sequence Tyr-Gly-Gly-Phe-Leu-Arg-Lys-Tyr-Pro-Lys. It's one of the two neoendorphins.

uses.text: Researchers and anatomists have not yet studied the distribution of α-neoendorphin in the human in detail.

pharmacology.en: It is a ten amino acid peptide that acts on opioid receptors, with a preference for the kappa receptor. Activating that receptor dampens pain signals and, in other drugs, tends to produce sedation rather than euphoria.
pharmacology.zh: 它是由十個胺基酸組成的胜肽，作用於鴉片受體，並偏好 kappa 受體。活化該受體會抑制疼痛訊號，而在其他藥物上，這通常帶來鎮靜而非愉悅感。
pharmacology.zhHans: 它是由十个胺基酸组成的胜肽，作用于鸦片受体，并偏好 kappa 受体。活化该受体会抑制疼痛信号，而在其他药物上，这通常带来镇静而非愉悦感。

fact.en: It is cut from the same precursor protein, prodynorphin, as the dynorphins. Its first five amino acids are identical to those of leucine enkephalin, a pattern shared by many of the body's own opioids.
fact.zh: 它與強度肽（dynorphin）切自同一個前驅蛋白 prodynorphin。它前五個胺基酸與白胺酸腦磷肽完全相同，這是許多體內自生鴉片物質共有的模式。
fact.zhHans: 它与强度肽（dynorphin）切自同一个前驱蛋白 prodynorphin。它前五个胺基酸与白胺酸脑磷肽完全相同，这是许多体内自生鸦片物质共有的模式。
